messages.author: 0521d492052ce0f0
messages.subject: An error has occurred... Worker asked to create wait channel was in stopped state.
parts:
Hi.  I'm a regular user of shinyapps.io.  I've recently been getting the following behaviour intermittently:

1) grey screen + 'disconnected from the server... reload'
2) reload, and get An error has occurred... Worker asked to create wait channel was in stopped state.

Wait a while... (1min? 3mins? not sure exactly) and it reloads ok.
Disconnected from the server.
I don't think I am doing anything radically different from previously, but googling this error message gives me zero hits.  

I cannot replicate the problem locally.  I cannot find a set of clicks on the webpage that repeatably generates the error.  I don't believe it is using really a lot of memory - locally running memory.size(max=F) returns 265.  I am a tier 1 customer.

Any help very welcome.  Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: An error has occurred... Worker asked to create wait channel was in stopped state.
parts:
I did not resolve this, and it is now more or less repeatable ie happens a lot.  

I have installed R3.4 and all packages on a fresh build Windows 10 machine.  The application runs fine locally.  On an attempt to deploy the process runs all the way to completion and shows in the Rstudio 'deploy' secreen no errors, and ends 'Application succcessfully deployed...' and 'Deployment completed... ' and the default browser (chrome) points to the https://amberalpha.shinyapps.io/gui1/ URL as expected, but shows 'An error has occurred Connection attempts were not successful before cancelled' - a phrase which generates zero results in a google search.  This is message is viewable at that URL.

The same shiny app which caused the original problem is also (previously) published at https://amberalpha.shinyapps.io/ppdrelease3 - it deployed fine, and also works fine until a large number is input in the radius widget, at which point the error is thrown which is the title of this thread.  I cannot reproduce this locally, I use only relative filepaths, I have afaik no os-specific or case-insensitive bits.  It is however true that a file gets deleted and written - could I be out of resources?  I have larger apps that run fine, this is not a demanding one.  I have archived three other apps to free up resources - to no avail.  I looked at the js log but does not cast any light (to me - don't know enough to say really).  It is also true that it is 'intermittent' to some degree - putting in a value of 550 sometimes causes the error immediately, sometimes no.

Any assistance much appreciated - I will open a 'basic tier' ticket in 24h if no-one has a solution or a debugging route I can use, but I thought I'd ask the community first just in case.  Apologies for a long post.  Thanks in advance!

messages.subject: Re: An error has occurred... Worker asked to create wait channel was in stopped state.
parts:
Thanks for your help.  I have added a memory diagnostic using pryr::mem_used() to the sidepanel, but it seems like the maximum is being transiently exceeded inside my functions - this is despite using data.table, and probably relates directly to me making copy() of reactive data tables to avoid unwanted dependencies.  

This suggests I should either go for larger instances or understand better how I can use reactive() without doing copy() inside, which I currently do to avoid any possible unwanted dependencies that I don't understand.

I think when this has happened in the past, reload did in fact immediately reload the app, whereas now the error message which is the title of this post comes up, and one has to wait 1-2 minutes before a reload is successful.  Is this a new feature, and is it really very rare for people to enounter this?  Is there any particular guidance on using data.table with reactives or is it not recommended?

Thanks in advance.
